meta.title: Over-Ordering Config: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Configure or verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and Over-Ordering Config setting.
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that user's RBAC access.
Attempt awarding beyond the requested quantity within the configured tolerance.
Repeat the action as a Buyer and compare availability or refusal.
Switch between the non-Buyer and Buyer identities in the same tenant.
